notes.title: Update　Ver1.2
notes.content:
<Update Details> (Updated February 2025)
Addition of water simulation function
A simulation that realistically reproduces water behavior has been implemented.
The following four patterns of water behavior can be experienced
Water vs Water (Merge) Water merges with each other
Water vs Water (Split) Water splits
Water vs Ball (Rebound) Water hits a sphere and is reflected
Water vs Ball (Penetrate) Water penetrates a sphere
The water simulation can be accessed from a PC near the intoball in Kibo. It can be easily manipulated through the interactive UI.

Improved visuals
Exterior is now visible from the cupola and from the kibo.

Gameplay improvements
The appearance of the control robot is now intball2.
Summoned robots now look like intball2.

Bug fixes
The brightness of the lights in the ship has been adjusted to the proper brightness.
Unnecessary intballs are now automatically deleted to avoid the intball proliferation bug.

notes.title: Ver1.1　Update
notes.content:
＜Bug Fix＞
Improved judging of hit detection
Fixed a mistake in operation explanation.
Improved UI layout.
Fixed a bug that the direction of the sun and the position of the light source hitting the earth were opposite.

＜Additional Features＞
Added Japanese language support. Added language setting.
Changed the loading screen so that an operation explanation is displayed at the start of the game.
The camera is now transparent when the player is close to the camera.
Pause the game while the menu screen is displayed.
Vertical synchronization is now supported. Vertical synchronization can be selected from settings.
The loading screen has been changed.
Fixed a bug that prevented operation when switching between full screen mode and window mode.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)
